Member 2 and Member 3 must copy the eligibility, benefit and documents EXACTLY from the official page (source_url), have the Kannada checked, then set verified=true and fill last_checked. name.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಜೀವನ ಜ್ಯೋತಿ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ

benefit.en: Rs 2 lakh life insurance cover for death due to any reason. One-year cover, renewable every year. Premium: Rs 436 per year, deducted from your account.

why.en: No insurance on file, and you have a bank account.
why.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ವಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಇದೆ.

eligibility_text.en: Bank or post office account holders aged 18 (completed) to 50 who give consent to join and enable auto-debit. You can join through one bank or post office account only. Cover ends at age 55, with yearly renewal.

documents.en: Bank or post office account with enough balance for the yearly premium
Aadhaar (the main KYC for the bank or post office account)
Enrolment and auto-debit consent form (the bank or post office gives the prescribed form)

how_to_apply.en: Give your consent and auto-debit option on the prescribed form to your bank or post office. The premium of Rs 436 per year is then deducted from your account in one payment. The cover runs 1 June to 31 May, and joining late costs less premium.

benefit.en: Accident cover for one year, renewable every year. Rs 2 lakh for death or total disability from an accident, and Rs 1 lakh for loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot. Premium: Rs 20 per year, deducted from your account.

why.en: No insurance on file, and you have a bank account.
why.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ವಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಇದೆ.

eligibility_text.en: Bank or post office account holders aged 18 (completed) to 70 who give consent to join and enable auto-debit. You can join through one bank or post office account only. Cover ends at age 70.

documents.en: Bank or post office account with enough balance for the yearly premium
Aadhaar (the main KYC for the bank or post office account)
Enrolment and auto-debit consent form (the bank or post office gives the prescribed form)

how_to_apply.en: Give your consent and auto-debit option on the prescribed form to your bank or post office. The premium of Rs 20 per year is then deducted from your account in one payment. The cover runs 1 June to 31 May. If you join later, you pay the full annual premium.

benefit.en: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 (you choose) after age 60, until death. Your spouse gets the same pension after you, and then your nominee gets the savings built up to age 60.

why.en: Good for building a savings habit, and you have a bank account.
why.kn: ಉಳಿತಾಯ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು, ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಇದೆ.

eligibility_text.en: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account in a bank or the Department of Posts. Anyone who is or has been an income-tax payer cannot join (rule from 1 October 2022).

documents.en: Savings bank account in a bank or post office
APY Registration Form (available at bank branches and post offices)

how_to_apply.en: Fill in the APY Registration Form and submit it at your bank branch or post office. You can also join online through eAPY. You pay the prescribed contribution from the age you join until age 60.

why.en: Low logged income and no insurance on file.
